facts.business: Crizac is an AI-native global mobility platform that connects students, counselling partners, and universities through an intelligent, data-driven ecosystem to facilitate international student journeys from ambition to confirmed university seat.
facts.related_party_note: Revenue from operations primarily comprises IT processing fees charged to subsidiaries based on student applications processed. Determination of pricing for such transactions with related parties involves significant judgement with respect to transfer pricing considerations and arm's length assessment.
